newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING says Q1 helped by favourable markets.
newsitem.headline: ING says Q1 helped by favourable markets.

text.p: ING Groep NV (ING) said favourable markets helped it lift financial transaction income and assets under management in the first quarter of 1997.

ING said results from financial transactions showed a strong rise of 40.2 percent to 328 million guilders. "Favourable market conditions contributed to the substantial increase of the result from securities and currency trading," the Dutch group said.

ING Asset Management's assets under management increased about five percent to 258 billion guilders. "This was due to the inflow of new assets as well as the favourable stock exchange climate and higher exchange rates," ING said.
The funds managed by ING Investment Management and Baring Asset Management showed a good performance in general.
ING also said commission income increased 36.8 percent to 814 million guilders in the first quarter of 1997.

"In addition to a considerable increase at ING Barings and Baring Asset Management, the other operations reported higher commission income from securities and corporate finance," it said, adding that commission from insurance broking showed a distinct increase.
